description.value: The Old Farm Market is a locally beloved independent grocery chain, voted #1 Best Local Grocery Store in the Comox Valley, with a focus on farm-fresh produce at competitive prices. The Courtenay location features an in-house bakery producing fresh goods daily and a made-to-order sandwich counter with unlimited veggies, sauce, and guacamole. It is one of three Vancouver Island locations operated by the same family-run business.
